rows.heading: Study Leave Service Bond
rows.quote_snippet: 7.1 Mandatory Service Bond Execution: Every executive granted study leave shall execute a formal legal service bond with two solvent sureties prior to proceeding on leave, binding themselves to serve the Corporation for a minimum period of 3 (three) completed years upon resumption of duty following completion of the study course.

rows.heading: Study Leave Service Bond
rows.quote_snippet: 7.2 Financial Penalty on Breach: In the event of resignation, abandonment of service, or dismissal within 3 years of returning from study leave, the executive shall be liable to refund in full to the Corporation: (a) The entire amount of leave salary, allowances, tuition fees, and book grants paid during the period of study leave; (b) Travel costs, airfares, and visa fees incurred by the Corporation; and (c) Compound interest thereon calculated at the prevailing commercial bank lending rate plus 2% per annum from the date of payment.

rows.heading: Short Title and Commencement
rows.quote_snippet: 1.3 Right to Leave: Leave cannot be claimed as a matter of right. When the exigencies of public service so require, the Competent Authority reserves the discretion to refuse, revoke, curtail, or postpone leave of any description.
